issues.reason: No word in the sentence supplies the kind "district" for Downtown Washington, so the atom fails Core patterns' "point at the words that put the atom there" test — a proper noun's type atom is licensed only when a kind word sits inside the name or beside it ("the Brindle estuary"), which is why the parallel virginia correctly carries a Name and nothing else.

gaps_confirmed: coordinated NPs as the object of one locative PP ("in Downtown Washington and northern Virginia") — the distributive-by-default rule is stated for coordinated arguments, not for stacking two obliques on one event

a causation-flavored verb ("triggered") whose object is an event-denoting NOUN rather than a clausal complement — the role test points at Patient while the causative bullet points at Theme for a reified complement
distributing a group predication to its members by rule when the group fills a non-subject role (Theme of "inconvenienced") — the per-member rule is specified only for plural subjects
new_gaps: a sentence-initial demonstrative ("That triggered ...") whose referent is an eventuality in prior text: with no in-item antecedent the anaphora rule yields an untyped-kind `thing` witness, so the eventive character of the antecedent is not recoverable
repair_summary: Removed (Member downtown_washington district), the invented kind atom; downtown_washington now carries only its Name atom, exactly as virginia does.
notes: Everything else stands: the single capitalized run as one name, the northern-Virginia sub-region witness, the phrasal back_up with no genus, the 47-hour duration Measure on the event-noun witness, and the vague-quantity CardinalityPhrase. The As atom's anchoring on the relative-clause event is a defensible attachment and was not filed as an issue.
